bundle_shift_swap_desc: Shift swap requests between employees: propose, accept, apply as a manager.
shift_swap_confirm_delete_swap: Delete this swap? The shifts will be reverted to their original state.
shift_swap_error_shifts_different_stores: Shifts must belong to the same store.
shift_swap_feature_swaps_desc: Propose and accept shift swaps with colleagues.
shift_swap_no_future_shift_colleague: This colleague has no future shifts.
notif_swap_accepted_body: Your shift swap (:req_date for :tgt_date, :store) was accepted.
notif_swap_applied_body: A shift swap was applied to your schedule: :req_date for :tgt_date (:store).
notif_swap_cancelled_restored_body: The shift swap (:req_date for :tgt_date, :store) was cancelled, your shifts have been restored to their original state.
notif_swap_peer_accepted_body: :colleague accepted the shift swap (:my_date ↔ :target_date, :store) — pending validation.
notif_swap_refused_body: Your shift swap request (:req_date for :tgt_date, :store) was refused.
shift_swap_select_employees_to_continue: Select two different employees to continue.
shift_swap_step_2_my_shift: 2. My shift (that I want to swap)
shift_swap_step_3_his_shift: 3. His shift (that I want to take)
shift_swap_swap_accepted_wait_manager: Swap accepted — waiting for manager validation.
shift_swap_swap_conflict_error: This swap would create a conflict: one of the employees would end up with two shifts on the same day.
shift_swap_swap_conflict_hint: Shifts that would create a conflict (the other employee already has a shift that day) are not offered.
shift_swap_swap_deleted: The swap was deleted and the shifts were reverted to their original state.
